note: One garment, sent by the client on WhatsApp at 20:58 with the caption 'could you possible post this kit. available small to 2xl / R550 / Argentina 2026 Farewell Kit'. Two photographs, front and back of the same shirt — ONE listing with two images. Caption screenshot kept at import/batch-1014-raw/caption-1.png.
pricing: R550 is the client's own price for this shirt and is a tier of its own: it sits between the standing fan version (R500, S-4XL) and player version (R650, S-2XL) of the 7 Sep price list. The S-2XL size run is the client's too. Both come straight from the caption — do not 'correct' either to a standing tier.
dedupe: Checked by eye against contact sheets of the lead photograph of all 28 live Argentina listings. No match: nothing live carries the Messi M mark, and no other Argentina shirt is a plain sky body with one broad white centre stripe. Clear to create.

garments.title: Argentina 2026 Messi Farewell Kit
garments.blurb: A sky blue short-sleeve shirt with one broad white stripe down the centre front and back, a sunburst of fine horizontal lines fanning out from it. The AFA crest sits on the right of the chest with three stars above it, the Messi M mark opposite, and the ribbed collar and cuffs are navy edged in gold.
garments.context: The Argentina 2026 Farewell Kit is a special edition marking Lionel Messi's final international appearance for Argentina, which is why it carries his own mark alongside the national crest rather than a sponsor.
